symmetry: input renaming + output complement; no input negation
scope: Prospective within-SLURP compositional transfer protocol. Requires fresh runs from a fact-only initializer and per-version runtime gates. Not cross-dataset transfer, speaker isolation or evidence of gains.

learning.scope: Independent truth/provenance/arm audit of learning-only controls; no model score or generalization evidence

selection.scope: Independent source/semantic-review bindings and Boolean rule arithmetic; not listening, runtime admission or proof of no historical evaluation exposure

parity_requirement: Independent HF reload and native vLLM full-action gate for every exported version and every next-update request
initializer_requirement: Pinned fact-only SFT; no prior rule-training checkpoint allowed
checkpoint_selection: Fixed terminal update, no selection-score picking
budget_scope: Same request/update exposure; record tokens, audio duration, rollout and device time separately; not FLOPs matched
